{{Top|leg}}
A '''tracer program''' was a program that could be piggybacked onto transmissions and used to locate the recipient. One such program was used to locate [[Tak Base]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base on [[Talay/Legends|Talay]], which was then destroyed by [[Dark Trooper/Legends|Dark troopers]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
